meta.purpose: Health/availability context that NO feed carries. Recorded as explicit sourced entries, NEVER as an inferred adjustment: nothing here changes a rating. Its only job is to say which prior-year rates are known to be unrepresentative, so a number is not read as a clean estimate of ability.
meta.rule: An entry requires a named source. 'No reliable reporting found' is recorded as such rather than left blank. Never infer an injury from a drop in playing time -- playing time is already visible.

players.name: Brooklyn DeLeye
players.detail: Played essentially all of 2025 with a torn meniscus in her left knee, injured early vs Nebraska; postponed surgery to keep playing; still 2025 AVCA First-Team All-American. Post-season surgery, ~4-week recovery.

players.name: Teraya Sigler
players.detail: Back injury in the second half of 2025 that limited her athleticism; mostly a back-row role behind Taylor Landfair. Reported fully healthy in spring 2026.

players.name: Charlie Fuerbringer
players.detail: Shoulder injury Oct 5 2025 vs Michigan; missed the next nine matches. Wisconsin went 6-3 without her.

players.name: Ella Swindle
players.detail: Lower-left-leg injury in practice, Sept 2025; walking boot, missed time.
players.status_2026: healthy, but not projected first-choice in Texas's 6-2

players.name: Mckenna Wucherer
players.detail: Redshirted 2025 with a back injury. Her 764 career kills were the most on Minnesota's 2025 roster, so she is a returning contributor with NO 2025 production line -- the churn and roster-delta terms cannot see her.

players.name: Maeva Schalk
players.detail: Did not play in 2025 due to injury; on the 2026 roster.
